subject: Quick questions before demo: Catalogue.ai integration
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex@catalogue.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T17:12:43-08:00
Subject: Demo request from self-serve signup

Hi Sergio,

I signed up for a trial earlier today (Company: Catalogue.ai) and would love a short walkthrough of Redwood to see if it fits our use case. Quick context: we handle customer support transcripts and want to move from a rules-based triage to LLM-driven intent classification + summarization.

Estimated volume: ~5M tokens/month to start, likely to grow. Peak concurrency: not sure but we expect spikes during business hours (roughly 9am-6pm PST).

Timeline: looking to pilot in January and evaluate for a production rollout in Q2.

Would appreciate 30 minutes next week to see a demo and ask a few technical questions. My timezone is PST (UTC-8). Best times: Mon/Tue afternoon PST or Wed morning PST.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Product
Catalogue.ai

---
Attachment: self-serve-signup.csv (stub)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@catalogue.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T18:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request from self-serve signup

Hi Alex — thanks for signing up and for the context. I’m Sergio on the SDR/solutions side; looping in Marissa (AE) who will lead the demo. A few quick questions so we tailor the walkthrough: 

- Primary goal: is the focus intent classification + extractive summarization, or do you want generation/assistant-style replies as well?
- Can you confirm the 5M tokens/month estimate: is that tokens generated by the model, tokens ingested (embedding + LLM), or combined?
- Peak concurrency: you noted spikes — is peak concurrent QPS closer to 20, 30, or 50?
- Data sensitivity: will the input include customer PII or regulated data? Any SOC2 / HIPAA requirements?
- Timeline and success criteria: what would success look like for a January pilot vs. a Q2 production rollout?
- Availability: our Calendly is below — share a few slots that work and we’ll lock it in. We typically do a 30m technical demo + 15m follow-up for deeper infra/security questions if needed.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/sergio-redwood/30min
Quick one-pager attached for context.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez | SDR, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: redwood-demo-onepager.pdf (stub)
From: Alex Johnson <alex@catalogue.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-11T09:15:30-05:00
Subject: Re: Demo request from self-serve signup

Hi Sergio — thanks for the quick reply and the one-pager. Answers below: 

- Primary goal: intent classification + extractive summarization for support tickets. We may experiment with short-form reply suggestions later, but not in the pilot.
- Token estimate: 5M is combined (ingest + generation). We expect ~60% ingest (embeddings/search) / 40% generation.
- Peak concurrency: we expect up to ~30 concurrent requests during peak (US business hours).
- Data sensitivity: transcripts include customer names and emails; no PHI, but we must meet SOC2 and have an audit trail.
- Success criteria: pilot (Jan): achieve >= 80% accuracy on triage labels and <200ms median latency for classification. Production (Q2): 99.9% availability SLAs, integration into our support workflow.
- Availability next week (PST):
  * Tue 2026-12-15 1:00pm–3:30pm PST
  * Wed 2026-12-16 9:00am–11:00am PST
  * Thu 2026-12-17 10:00am–12:00pm PST

Let me know what you and Marissa prefer. Also, we have a short SOC2 questionnaire — can you share an evidence packet or point person?

Regards,
Alex
